messages:
Omar Castro: Hey everyone — Omar here, first day on Platform Eng. Came from a fintech infra team. Quick setup Qs: MDM enrollment completed but I can't access the redwood-github org (403). Who do I ping for org invites? Also where do I find infra runbooks? Favorite snack: mate + empanadas.
Priya Rao: Welcome Omar! :wave: Ping @Sam Wells for GitHub invites, i'll add you to #eng-platform and share the handbook link. Empanadas = excellent choice.
Sam Wells: Sent the invite to your email just now — accept and refresh. If it's not there check spam. I'll add you to the org teams once it's accepted.
mdm-bot: Device enrolled, but certificate for KMS access missing. Please run:
```
sudo /usr/local/bin/redwood-mdm-check --send
```
and paste the output to #it-help.
Maya - IT: If the mdm-check shows cert error i'll take it from there. Also for cluster access we need a short infra access form — i'll DM you the link.
Tess Lee: Hi Omar! I'm your onboarding buddy. Want to do a quick sync today? Here's the 1st-week checklist: https://confluence.redwood.ai/onboarding/first-week (bookmark it). Also sticker drawer is near the kitchen :sticker: 
Alex Nguyen: If you'll be doing runtime dev, install the devcontainer extension and this repo settings will land you in the right container:
`code --install-extension redwood.devcontainer && Reopen in Container`
Omar Castro: Thanks all — accepted the invite and ran mdm-check. Output looks like:
"CERT_MISSING: kms-client.pem"
I'll paste full output to #it-help now. Also, where are the rollout runbooks for serving runtime? Curious who owns --dedicated cluster access.
Priya Rao: Runbooks are under Confluence > Ops > Runbooks > Serving Runtime. For dedicated clusters ping Maya, she'll route to infra eng. Welcome to the team!
Tess Lee: Lunch tomorrow? My treat, empanadas on me. :tada:
